{{Top}}
'''Weather control''' was the use of technology to control a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] weather using a [[weather-control station]]. Planets such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] stopped rain and storms, so that it only rained once a month. On the planet [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]], weather control was used to create [[sweeper storm]]s. On [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], the lava flow was controlled by weather systems in order to prevent them from flooding, and to protect the citizens from explosions. The ''[[Ionic Ring Ship]]'', [[Pasarian Memorial Atmospheric Reclamation Complex Project]], and [[atmospheric dampener]]s were other examples of weather control technology.
